title: Liveness (dead-man's switch)
summary: The dispatcher writes a heartbeat every tick, even while halted; a separate systemd timer checks its age and alerts the owner (owner channel + optional push URL through the external gate) when it is older than 3 ticks; the dispatcher checks the watcher's heartbeat back.

tools.purpose: the dead-man's switch from a shell: both heartbeats, a test ping, one watcher check
